title: IMAP4rev2: NAMESPACE, STATUS=SIZE, and SASL-IR support
description: Implement NAMESPACE (RFC 2342): return personal namespace prefix in NAMESPACE response. Implement STATUS=SIZE (RFC 8438): include SIZE in STATUS responses (total octets of all messages). Implement SASL-IR (RFC 4959): handle initial client response in AUTHENTICATE command to reduce round-trips. Blocked on: stoa-31b7b082.
